from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u073/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                comp.append((y, x, grid[y][x]))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] != bg and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            comps.append(comp)
    template = max(comps, key=len)
    r0, r1 = min(p[0] for p in template), max(p[0] for p in template)
    c0, c1 = min(p[1] for p in template), max(p[1] for p in template)
    ar, ac = (r0+r1)//2, (c0+c1)//2
    offsets = [(r-ar, c-ac, v) for r,c,v in template]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for comp in comps:
        if comp is template:
            continue
        if len(comp) == 1:
            r, c, _ = comp[0]
            for dr, dc, v in offsets:
                y, x = r+dr, c+dc
                if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                    out[y][x] = v
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-ff293dc5.py'
path.write_text(code)
print(path)
